notes.title: Park Studio Beta 1.0 Development Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello dear enthusiasts!

I'm Azael, the developer of Park Studio.



Today, I would like to share with you all everything I've been working on the past few months for the upcoming Beta update.


What is Beta 1.0?


Early this year, I announced that the next update would be Beta 1.0, but I didn't really explain what its goal was or what would be in it.



So, Beta 1.0 will be a complete rewrite of the game from the ground up, this was done in order to be more performant, and ensure quality and stability.

The update will bring back all Alpha features, this includes the building features, coaster features, landscape features, as well as some previously removed features such as Undo & Redo.

On top of that, Beta 1.0 will also introduce new features, more content and some great improvements to existing features. I won't share everything today, but look forward to more coaster types, new special tracks like switch tracks and turn tables and some major improvements to the coaster features.


Development Update


Let's now take a look at everything I've been working on, everything that you'll see below is still work in progress and subject to change.


Main Menu Redesign

Design & Navigation


The main menu was redesigned, it is now back to the left side similarly to Alpha 0.1. The new design is more visually pleasing and easier to navigate.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983429/2ae51613d4f2d2640563e6250ad45a36de59d301.png"]New Main Menu UI and background.



The background has also been reworked (WIP), and it will be updated as the game gets new features. The background will also have seasonal additions based on upcoming events or seasons like Halloween.



[img src="https://i.imgur.com/v7ajjzz.gif"]Main Menu navigation, easier than ever.


New Settings


New settings were added, especially new graphics settings, these new settings were added to support a wider range of hardware with more fine-tuning to get the best looking game while keeping framerate high.



[img src="https://i.imgur.com/GLN09Ol.gif"]New graphics settings.


Graphics Update


Speaking of graphics, the entire game's lighting and post processing has been redone to follow a Physically Based Lighting approach, which means Park Studio aims to simulate photo-realism.



The recent graphics improvements (WIP) were showcased in a recent video, you can watch it on the YouTube channel.


[previewyoutube="NUKxwYCX4G8;full"][/previewyoutube]

Performance Upgrade


Beta 1.0 will be far more optimized than the Alpha, ensuring a smooth 60 fps on the High settings, no matter the size or amount of content in your park, with minimal quality losses.



The update will also boost the Epic settings for image quality and stability, so it will be recommended to use Frame Generation, as the game only targets 45 fps on the Epic settings.


In-Game UI Redesign


Similarly to the Main Menu redesign, the in-game UI has also been refreshed, following the same consistent design and ease of navigation.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983429/73dafec2dea4c7ba13a6e05bdea1cdc8b881ae43.png"]In-Game UI on a flat map.



The redesign uses a similar layout and philosophy to Alpha 0.2. The goal is to have a maximum of free space in your view, so that the UI doesn't get in your way.



You might notice some pretty interesting changes to the UI, starting at the top left, there are two new buttons compared to the Alpha, these are the Photo Mode tool and Camera Modes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983429/a1e0a18ebdc34143f8d94c49a419ccfa9d9780e2.png"]

The Photo Mode won't be part of the initial Beta 1.0 release, but it will come soon after, while the Camera Modes button will allow you to switch between the camera modes, these include: Drone, Walk and a brand new camera mode: Orbit.

The Orbit camera was a very requested feature, and I'm happy to announce that it will be added to Beta 1.0.



Then, at the top of the screen, there is a brand new UI element that I called the "Controls Bar"

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983429/487502efd0a613818f72bc8f374c29b1cb86652d.png"]

The "Controls Bar" is a dynamic UI element that will show you a list of controls that you can use, it will update as you navigate different menus or do different actions to show you exactly what shortcuts are available to you.

The "Controls Bar" can be disabled in the settings, if you don't want to see it.



Finally, at the bottom of the screen are your classic park controls and building buttons.


Park Management
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983429/dd0f5181f52a902420b6ecb9c1a20f331eebaf88.png"]

WIP Park Management Menu.



Park Management will be a feature available in the future, this is just an early design iteration for that menu, nothing here is functional except changing the name of your park.


Time & Weather
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983429/38608eab7bd800f6feae856ae1fa6ca41b578330.png"]

WIP Time & Weather Menu.



A brand new Time and Weather Menu was added, in order to give you control over the time of day, the weather and simulation speed all in one place.



You might notice a couple of new features, such as temperature, the calendar, seasons and the weather forecast.

All of these features are still work in progress and will be discussed in future devlogs, but for now I can reveal some information.

The temperature will affect your visitors and the ability for your rides to operate, the weather forecast will give you tips to ensure your visitor's happiness in all kinds of weather and the calendar will allow you to setup custom events such as celebrations, seasonal events or sales.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983429/00a8ae37de1d28e68797d4ea6e13d16264264bdb.png"]

Example of weather forecast tips.


Building Features Improvements


The Building features of Park Studio were massively improved, starting with the core: Selecting pieces.



[img src="https://i.imgur.com/YCZbWHn.gif"]Improved way to select pieces in Beta 1.0.



As you can see on the gif above, selecting pieces is now very different compared to what it was in Alpha 0.2. Where Park Studio previously followed the common trend of the game genre, it now innovates with a more efficient and user-friendly way of selecting pieces and materials.



In Beta 1.0, some of the pieces will have families, and once you click on a "parent" of that family, it will open all of the pieces from that family, avoiding an unending list of pieces in a cluttered menu.



Materials were separated from the pieces entirely, where before you had 21 times every piece, you now only have one family of blank pieces, on which you can apply any material you want in one click.



Another major change is that the Scenery and Building pieces will now be merged in one single menu, with new filters and tags to search exactly the piece you want very quickly and easily.


Improved Building Controls


The controls were improved, where before you had to use your mouse wheel to move pieces up and down or rotate them, you will now be able to move your mouse on the screen in the direction you want the piece to go or rotate.



More improvements to the controls are coming as well as some new features to make building easier!


Introducing: the Spline Tools


The first brand new tool to join the Beta 1.0 toolset: the Spline Tools!



The spline tools are coming as a replacement and extension to the Path Tool. With the Spline Tools, you will be able to draw fences, paths, curbs, coaster supports and more.



This tool is still heavily work in progress, but here is a first look at how you'll be able to draw a fence that sticks to the terrain with ease.



[img src="https://i.imgur.com/IiXKXiz.gif"]Spline Tools in action, drawing a fence on uneven terrain in a few clicks.


Major Terrain Improvements


The Terrain features of Park Studio were drastically improved, with improved visuals, faster sculpting and material painting and new features.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983429/f1782556c7711f959693749ad200be899c259470.png"]Improved terrain visuals with better transitions between grass and rock.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983429/bda698514bd622e192e455eea1921cc6d2592670.png"]New: displacement on terrain, adding real 3D detail to the surfaces.


Introducing: Terrain Stamps


Another brand new tool unique to Park Studio: Terrain Stamps!



Terrain Stamps work similar to pieces, but for your terrain! You might notice on the screenshot above that the terrain has very fine shapes, these were made with Terrain Stamps, combined with sculpting.



[img src="https://i.imgur.com/n9GatF7.gif"]Terrain Stamps in action, placing shapes in one click.



[img src="https://i.imgur.com/P926oVi.gif"]Moving stamps even after they are placed.



Terrain Stamps can be sculpted and painted over, making them your best friends for all your landscaping needs!


New Painting Features


Beta 1.0 will introduce three new painting features on top of simply painting materials: Painting Puddles, Wetness and Color!



[img src="https://i.imgur.com/YZVyTCW.gif"]Painting materials.



[img src="https://i.imgur.com/8Jm58VW.gif"]Painting colors, puddles and wetness.


The Future


This concludes everything I've been working on the last few months! While it is a lot of work and improvements, this merely scratches the surface of what I plan to release in Beta 1.0, as a little gift, let me share with you the first part of the brand new timeline!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983429/a7c9405a0f2a97e3a6b3693661c47e8b9570d0db.png"]

I still have a lot of work to do, the next steps are the new coaster builder, with improved features and new coaster types, and adding building and scenery pieces.



Thank you so much for reading, I truly hope this extensive development update satisfies you all!



A quick reminder that if you'd like to support the project, there is a Patreon available, it doesn't offer anything just yet but after Beta 1.0, you will get access to early builds and exclusive looks at upcoming features! The Patreon is the best way to support me and the project.



Stay tuned as more will be revealed in the near future, as I keep making progress developing Park Studio's biggest update yet!

notes.title: Park Studio Alpha 0.2.0 (Phase 1) Release
notes.notes:
Please note that while in its Alpha stage, we cannot guarantee Park Studio will work reliably on all hardware, please report any bugs or crashes you encounter. Bug reports will be fixed as soon as possible.

DISCLAIMER:

Alpha 0.2.0 is not the full "0.2" release, we are changing the way we release updates to provide more regular, feature rich updates. This means that an update such as 0.2 will be complete when all features are implemented via smaller updates. 0.2 is planned to be complete with 0.2.2!

Park Studio Alpha 0.2.0 has been released, here is what it currently includes:

- Coaster Builder Improvements: The coaster builder received a major upgrade, introducing a "Curve Tool" that allows for a better coaster building experience with automatic tangents! Nodes are still available for fine-tuning!

- Special Track Elements: Jump Tracks, Drop Tracks, Tilt Tracks and much more are waiting to be added to your coasters!

- Improved Coaster Physics: Coaster physics were drastically improved, and new customization options were added to control them further!

- Water Tools: Create Rivers around and in your parks! More water features such as lakes and oceans are coming soon!

- Foliage Painter: Using the brand new Foliage Painter, easily create forests or populate your park with grass, bushes and rocks!

- New Coaster Models: Go Beyond Vertical with the new Mug Rides LSM Launch Coaster "Comet", inspired by the Mack Rides Stryker Coaster, and soon, a brand new coaster type will turn your park upside down!

- CSV Track Importer: Import your coasters from other software directly in Park Studio using the CSV importer!

Coming next in Park Studio Alpha 0.2.1

Here are the features planned for release Alpha 0.2.1, coming soon.

- Additional Special Tracks: Switch Tracks, Transfer Tracks and other special tracks will come to complete the library of Special Tracks!

- New & Improved Water Tools: Water bodies will be added, along with a water shader overhaul allowing for better flowing water and scenery interactions!

- Prefabs & Steam Workshop: Prefabs will allow you to save your builds and share them on the Steam Workshop!

- Media Importer and Media Scenery: Screens, Flags, Speakers and more are coming to take your park to the next level with custom imported media!

- Menu Filters: Menu filters will come back to improve your experience when browsing the thousands of objects available in Park Studio!

- Track Components & Sounds: Better track components (LSM, Brakes) will come with sound and animations!

- Undo & Redo: Currently disabled in 0.2.0, Undo & Redo will come back in 0.2.1!

- Coaster Station Improvements: Coaster stations will be able to have a continuous movement, and trains will be able to open gates per row!

More features are planned to release in Alpha 0.2.2! Learn more on the trello.

CURRENT LIMITATIONS

- Special Tracks are still heavily Work In Progress, they are buggy especially with blocks, use with care.

- Special Track Elements cannot be inserted between nodes.

- Trains cannot go backwards with Special Track Elements, they will glitch out.

CHANGELOG

This update includes the following new features:

- New Camera Features: We added a few new Cinematic features to the Advanced Graphics Options, including color grading, depth of field, etc...

- Zoom: You can now Zoom using (C).

- POV Buttons on Train Cards: We added a few buttons to enter different camera positions on your trains via the Train Cards.

- Time Control: The Time and Weather Menu now includes new buttons to control time, you can slow down, stop or speed up time.

- New Upscaler : Nvidia DLSS 3.7 has been added, including DLSS, DLAA and NIS. (Note: Upscalers are not a solution to performance issues, they are only here to help with performance while we do our best to improve the game's bottlenecks.)

This update includes the following improvements:

- Massively Improved Performance: We optimized a lot of systems across the game, including lighting and materials and fixed some performance issues that were found before the initial release.

- Camera Speed and Mouse Sensitivity: You can now control the Flying and Walking camera speeds as well as the Mouse Sensitivity.

- Realistic Jump: We changed how the player character jumps, it should now be more realistic and less floaty.

- Menu Auto-Scaling: The Menus will now automatically scale up or down when you select/deselect an object or coaster, making it easier to browse the library while keeping viewport space when placing objects.

- Shader Pre-Compile Screen: We added a new Shader Compilation Screen when launching the game, this will compile all shaders allowing for a smoother game experience, you can disable the Pre-Compile Screen in the Options.

- New & Improved Main Menu: We improved the look and feel of the Main Menu.

- Interaction Crosshair: When in Walk Mode, if you look at an interactable object or coaster train, an interaction crosshair will appear indicating the object can be interacted with.

- Insert Node Improvements: When adding a node between two nodes, the new node will be inserted in the middle of the two others

- Arrive and Leave Tangents: Tangents are now separated between Arrive and Leave allowing for finer control over your curve's tangents.

- Auto Tangent Button: A new button to auto-calculate and apply tangents.

- Node Linking: Nodes can now be linked to each other, extending their settings without manual intervention.

- Snapping Improvements: Snapping can now snap to rotation and snap to scale.

- Hardware Ray Tracing Support: Support for Hardware Ray Tracing has been added, improving Ambient Occlusion, Reflections, Global Illumination and potentially improving performance on Ray Tracing capable graphic cards.

- Editable Coaster Friction: Coaster friction can be edited per coaster.

- Higher Resolution Terrain: Terrain resolution has been doubled, note that terrain paint may be reset.

- Units in Menus: Units are now displayed in Menus when needed.

- Longer Rain and Snow Coverage: Rain and Snow will last longer on the ground before melting or drying.

- New Terrain Textures: A few new terrain textures were added such as sand, leaves and gravel.

- New Foliage species: About a dozen new tree species were added including Pines, Palms, Oaks and more.

- Shadow Resolution Setting: A new setting that allows to control the "resolution" of shadows, this has very low impact on performance but can be useful.

Bug fixes:

- Nodes shouldn't reset colors anymore
- Grid Size can no longer be 0
- Decimals now display properly on supports settings
- All trains now have the same number of cars, name colors can still be adjusted per train
- Opening a closed loop coaster now removes the track components of the removed section
- Train audio issues were fixed
- The mouse should now be as responsive as your computer's mouse
- Park Name now saves and displays properly
- Opening the pause menu doesn't freeze the game
- Nodes can now be selected through terrain
- Node triggers were shortened to avoid overlapping track issues
- Fixed some typos
- The loading screen bar now displays 100% instead of 0% when loading has been completed

There are most probably more fixes that were forgotten, if issues persist, please report them again in the bug reports channel on the Discord.

Known Issues:

- Trains sometimes fold on themselves when switching from a Special Track to a normal track or when closing a coaster with a train on a special track or beyond.

- Blocks can bug with Special Tracks, they will not generate properly, especially with multiple Special Tracks.

- Closing a loop with Special Tracks currently only moves the last node to the first, this will be improved

notes.title: Park Studio Alpha 0.2 Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello dear enthusiats!

Sorry for the lack of game updates, we've been working very hard on Alpha 0.2 and the tons of features it will add!

Here is a little update on what we've been working on, and what is left to do!

Alpha 0.2 Development

Development of the next big update has started after the last game update, Alpha 0.1.2, starting by adding a ton of Quality of Life features and upgrades such as a button on coasters to enter a train or new camera features such as Depth of Field, Zoom and more!

https://i.imgur.com/4PoBCQb.jpegScreenshot taken in-game using the new camera features

Then, the main menu and game UI was nearly entirely redone and improved to be more visually pleasing and performant.

https://i.imgur.com/4Bb9pqh.pngBrand new Main Menu

Speaking of performance, the game has received massive performance upgrades and fixes making the game run at a smooth 60 fps on the recommended configuration, on top of that, Nvidia DLSS support was added, including DLSS, DLAA, RTX Vibrance and Frame Generation.

After that, the focus was on entirely redoing the system that handles saving and loading your parks, a complicated and time consuming task that took nearly a month to complete due to unforseen issues and limitations. Thankfully, the system is now in place and allows us to add features without breaking your saves.

The next big feature was then implemented: Water!

Using the brand new Water Tools, you will be able to create next generation lakes, rivers and seas with ease. The tools use the same systems as the building and path tools, allowing you to place, move and scale water pieces to fit your needs, and use a spline-based river system similar to the game's Path Tool.

https://i.imgur.com/BbeHNqi.pngWIP screenshot of the early implementation of rivers

Developed along with the Water Tools, the Foliage Painter was also implemented and will allow you to paint foliage with fine controls!

Finally, the most recently implemented feature was the CSV track importer, allowing you to import track layouts from other popular softwares such as NoLimits 2, a great coaster simulation software, directly into Park Studio!

https://i.imgur.com/jJss42s.pngNoLimits2 coaster imported into Park Studio

And that's all we've been working on since June this year!

What is left to do

Before the update's release, there is still a few major features to implement, including:


 The brand new coaster elements, such as turn tables, switch tracks, drop tracks and more!
 Prefabs and the Steam Workshop allowing you to share your creations with the community!
 Custom Media using screens and speakers to make your park truly yours!


And the brand new Coaster Models, including the incredible Comet, that was recently revealed on our Discord

https://i.imgur.com/5hU3EEN.jpeg
https://i.imgur.com/iV28knY.jpeg
https://i.imgur.com/sSySfEV.jpeg
WIP renders of the brand new Comet coaster
